framing.lineOfInquiry: Sakshi Verma (P00413) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE040
framing.alternate: Sakshi Verma (P00413) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sakshi Verma was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 40 other days (10 May – 29 Jun), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sakshi Verma's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: In contact with Aman Thakur since 2025-05-12, 28 days before the incident (10 calls, 5 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Ravi Jain since 2025-05-11, 28 days before the incident (1 calls, 5 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sakshi Verma was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as complainant, not as accused

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sakshi Verma's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Location inconsistency (requires air travel): Hall Bazaar, Amritsar → Chandni Chowk Market, Delhi, 400.99 km in 64.0 min

alternateHypotheses.test: Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.
